text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During lunch today, Air Groove comes
over to
ask Mejiro Dober about essential
oils.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For headaches, lavender and bergamot
are best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I recommend you use them with a
clay mask
before bed. It'll help you
relax.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A clay mask... Thanks. I'll give it a try.
You're
even more knowledgeable than I
heard you were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who did you hear about me from?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me, of course! I went an' told everyone
how smart
you are, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Taiki?! But it's not as if I know that much about essential oils...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so modest! You know
everythin' from
beauty care to healthy
habits, study hacks, and
even sleeping
tips!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone needs to know how much
learnin' ya
got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it makes me happy to hear you
say that,
but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me? Dober, you know a lot
about
essential oils, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I know a little. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm actually asking on Spe's behalf.
Her poor
stomach is always growling,
and I was wondering
if there are oils that
suppress hunger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Suppress hunger? I've heard of ones that
boost
appetite, but let's see... I suppose
something
minty would help...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following this, countless students start
consulting
Mejiro Dober about their
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I never seem to get enough sleep. Are
there any
essential oils that promote
better sleep or
something?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I want one that keeps you wide awake! I
know
someone who's dozing off all the
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Settle down, you two. You should both
use some
geranium oil to help calm your
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For muscle pain, I recommend using a
beeswax
cream mixed with lavender and
tea tree oil.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Beeswax? Ooh, I wonder if the wax will
have any
honey left on it? Sounds
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It won't, so don't try to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After having to deal with an endless
stream of
queries, Mejiro Dober is
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew... I can finally take a break...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-not really. It's not that big of a deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. I just hope I was able to
help
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No reason... I just needed to know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't plan on learning so much... It's
just tough
to live without them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The aromas help me relax and forget
about all
the bad stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The aromas help me relax and forget
about all
the bad stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I learned about them in order to protect
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there'd be such a demand
for my
expertise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should learn even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you so happy about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think? Then maybe I will. It'd be
nice to be
able to help others more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What, do you have something you want
to ask me
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
By the way, if you have anything you'd
like to
ask, I'd be glad to hear you out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! What does it matter to you?!
Why do
you want to know?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What I use? Oh, I don't want to talk
about myself.
It's embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you really that sad that I won't
answer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you really that sad that I won't
answer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can tell you the shop I
frequent...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The staff there are pretty nice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I'm heading to the shop
Mejiro
Dober recommended, when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. You.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was looking to get some new
oils.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't know anything about essential
oils, do
you? I guess it wouldn't kill me
to teach you a
little...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go together since we're
both here?
I'll help you pick some that
suit your needs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I go to the shop
together, and I
buy some nice essential
oils there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I go to the shop
together, and I
buy some nice essential
oils there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You want my recommendations?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You're horrible at managing your sleep
schedule
and maintaining a balanced
diet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You've been sleep-deprived because of
work
lately, and I've been worried about
whether
you're eating properly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should focus on fixing those
fundamental
parts of your life first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should focus on fixing those
fundamental
parts of your life first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Something like sweet marjoram can help
stabilize
your biorhythm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And for that... I think you can use sweet
marjoram
to help you relax.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But since you're always at your desk, I
bet your
back is under a lot of pressure
too. Eucalyptus
and rosemary might help
with that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But since you're always at your desk, I
bet your
back is under a lot of pressure
too. Eucalyptus
and rosemary might help
with that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I think it might be better if you try
smelling
them yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You didn't understand anything I just said, did you? Sigh. Just go back to your office for now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Can you wait for me in your office? I'll
bring you
some oils I have to sample.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Mejiro Dober brings a
massive
amount of essential oils to my
office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Mejiro Dober brings a
massive
amount of essential oils to my
office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So? How's the eucalyptus? Doesn't it
make you
feel like you're relaxing in a
forest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And this is the sweet marjoram. Do you
feel your
body getting warmer and
warmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here. Do you want to try smelling
the Damask
rose? It's supposed to be
extremely relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You look like such a slob right now... It's
fine if
you fall asleep or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's good. These are supposed to help
you
relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober keeps offering me
different
essential oils to smell, and I
end up having the
best nap of my life.

end up having the
best nap of my life.
